name: 19035 · Gladwyne, PA
findings: ZIP 19035 (Gladwyne) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19035 (Gladwyne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19035 (Gladwyne) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.
